description: Covers the red test import_from_external_interface_carries_provider_boundary_call_without_provider_body. Likely root cause: the runtime-demand or artifact handoff path reads world.lowered_body for a provider-boundary function whose module is interface-only. Provider-boundary calls must use interface/extern boundary facts and must not require a lowered provider body. Fix the seam where the body read occurs; do not synthesize provider bodies or add compatibility stubs.
title: Artifact seam: keep provider-boundary imports body-free
